headline: OpenAI reports Iran- and Russia-linked false-front influence campaigns using its models
summary: OpenAI reports that it banned two account clusters it attributes to separate Russian- and Iranian-origin influence operations. The company says one operated a purported Latin American research center and used unwitting local staff, fabricated documents and synthetic media; the other used seven journalist bylines to pitch articles and generated batches of social-media comments. OpenAI says some content appeared in real media outlets, and estimates the Russian-linked operation at category 5 and the Iranian-linked operation at category 4 on the Brookings Breakout Scale. These are company assessments based partly on its account data and open-source checks, not an independent audit of attribution or reach. Spanish-language reporting confirms that related false content circulated in the region, but the reviewed examples do not establish linkage to these account clusters; one superficially similar Ecuador recruitment fake was reported as circulating in 2025.
